name: What should I look for when choosing a front door for energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a front door for energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an energy-efficient front door, look for features like a low U-factor (which indicates heat transfer) and a high R-value (which measures insulating power). Doors with a polyurethane or polystyrene foam core offer superior insulation. Additionally, ensure the door has robust weatherstripping and a tight-fitting frame to prevent air leaks. High-quality glass in any sidelights or transoms should be double or triple-paned with low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings. These details contribute significantly to maintaining comfortable indoor temperatures, which is especially beneficial in Boise Heights.
acceptedAnswer.description: For energy efficiency, choose doors with low U-factors, high R-values, foam cores, robust weatherstripping, and high-quality insulated glass.
